item.title: Monitoring Everpure Cloud Azure Native Pool Health with Application Insights
item.description: Are you looking for a way to trend capacity and performance for an Everpure Cloud Azure Native storage pool inside Azure? The pool exposes a getHealthStatus action through ARM that returns bandwidth, IOPS, space and data reduction, but it only gives you a point in time. I wanted history and a dashboard, so I built a small Azure Function that calls it every minute and pushes the results into Application Insights as custom metrics.
